name: touch-rotate
description: Two raised fingertips beneath a complete curved rotation arrow.
useCase: Twist two fingertips around each other to rotate content.
misuse: Use a label to explain what the gesture changes and how it behaves in the application.

16.reason: Two raised fingertips stay below a separate curved movement arrow.

24.reason: The larger hand opens the fingertip gap and leaves more space below the curved arrow.
